title: Filter and combine iterator pipelines
summary: Discard failed parses, limit results, then combine iterators into labelled pairs. Verify that borrowing leaves input usable.

collection.clue: Owned vector type collecting successfully parsed unsigned integers

parse.clue: Adapter retaining only Some values produced by the parsing closure

success.clue: Result method discarding failures and wrapping successful payloads in Option

limit.clue: Adapter yielding at most the first requested number of parsed values

gather.clue: Consumer gathering the remaining iterator values

copy.clue: Adapter using the Copy trait to produce u32 values out of shared references

indices.clue: Adapter adding zero-based indices to iterator items

combine.clue: Adapter pairing items from the two iterators until either ends

equal.clue: Macro checking the labelled numeric pairs
